author: mwongj
release_notes: Fix repeated VOD synchronization while preserving the stable 1.21 enrichment features. Inventory cleanup, filter checks and tracked-source queries now operate only on the configured output roots, preserving independent test/live directories and their ownership records. Repeated series refresh batches advance past unchanged shows and cached-empty episode responses; active workers reserve output slots and missing-episode provider fetches remain bounded by the batch size. Includes regression coverage for changed episode stream IDs/UUIDs, series removals and switching output roots. Validated with 498 passing tests, including pinned minimum/current Dispatcharr native compatibility checks; five platform-specific tests skipped on Windows. Existing settings, plugin identity and prior release packages are preserved. Large cleanup backlogs may require a higher saved action runtime.
